Our baby girl was stillborn at 28 weeks. For easier reference - because a lot of people don't realize and don't do the math - that is 7 months. D&C (sometimes called D&E) literally rips a live baby apart, piece by piece. A chemicall abortion suffocates a live baby. In a late term abortion, the head (most times, the most difficult part to deliver) is delivered, then a sharp instrument is shoved inside the baby's skull, killing it and severing its spinal cord. Sometimes the action is so violent, the head comes off. Then the rest of the body is delivered. Abortion is evil and barbaric, and there is literally never a reason to abort a baby, medical or otherwise.
